pattern.description: Burst-read a sequence of consecutive volatile uint32_t status/result words from the RF result window at 0x2007ff0c..0x2007ff1c+ and discard them (drain response FIFO).
pattern.template_c: for (uint32_t i = 0; i < N; i++) { (void)*((volatile uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)(0x2007ff0cU + i * 4U)); }
